# Landscape Design

Landscape design: redesign a garden, backyard, patio, terrace or front yard in the style you want, from a photo in your MegaScenes library or from a description.

## What it does
Pick a photo of the place from your MegaScenes library and name the style, or describe it. Claude tells you the price and makes the new design, keeping the layout, house and boundaries of your photo.

**How the files are made:** each landscape design is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install landscape-design@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Landscape Design talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/landscape-design/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each landscape design uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The landscape designs show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_landscape_design_models` | Models for landscape designs with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_landscape_design_cost` | Exact price of one landscape design before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_landscape_design` | Starts one landscape design in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_landscape_design` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Redesign my latest MegaScenes garden photo in Mediterranean style"
- "Design a small Japanese style backyard with a stone path"
- "Turn my last patio photo into a modern outdoor lounge"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the landscape design (the photo you pick from your library, if any, and the style you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
